newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian shares end higher, banks and insurers lead.
newsitem.headline: Italian shares end higher, banks and insurers lead.

text.p: Italian shares closed slightly firmer on Tuesday led by the higher trend in banking stocks which overflowed into insurance shares with selective buying seen throughout the day, dealers said.

Bank stocks again gained from takeover and restructuring talk and Ambroveneto ended up 9.46 percent at 8,057 lire after being temporarily suspended at the 10 percent level. Insurance stocks also gained like Generali up 2.58 percent at 33,835 lire in the general interest for financial stocks, they added.
The all-share Mibtel index ended up 0.26 percent at 14,104 and the Mib30 index up 0.16 percent at 21,441.
